newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS TRIMMING STAKE IN TSMC.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TRIMMING STAKE IN TSMC.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV is selling off a small portion of its 34 percent stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Dutch newspapers reported on Saturday.

Philips informed the Taiwanese government on Friday of its intention to sell some 100 million TSMC shares, around two percent of its holding, on the Taipei stock exchange, several morning papers said.
The company was not immediately available for comment on the reports.
The Dutch electronics giant said last year that it intended to eventually reduce its stake in TSMC to 26 percent, but that it was under no pressure to do so and would wait for the right moment.
TSMC shares have risen sharply in 1997 from just 37 Taiwan dollars at the start of the year to their close at 158 Taiwan dollars on Saturday.
